name: Setana (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Setana town emblem in green and orange: a green lozenge-shaped device with a stylised letter e and an orange disc.
history: Municipal flag of Setana, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 September 2005.

features.role: Setana town emblem — a green lozenge-shaped device with a stylised letter e and an orange disc
